# SeekAPI — China Supply Check

SeekAPI helps find and screen China suppliers for a specified product, quantity and requirements. A successful China Supply Check returns three distinct evidence-backed China supplier candidates worth advancing to RFQ. Supplier RFQ-worthiness is separate from exact product qualification. Reports preserve observed price basis, MOQ fit, available identity evidence, source/time and field-specific unknowns; unsupported shortages are reported honestly.

Current payment: x402 live, 2.99 USDC on Base. Stripe Checkout USD 2.99 is being enabled and is not available to purchase. Free discovery and brief preparation use MCP. The existing confirmed purchase/run path is documented by live discovery. Status/result require independent signed-wallet authentication bound to the settled order. Supplier contact and RFQ execution are not included.

- Product: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check
- Public paid acceptance example: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check/sample
- MCP guide: https://seekapi.ai/for-agents
- Streamable HTTP MCP: https://api.seekapi.ai/mcp
- Current entity: https://seekapi.ai/about
- Directory status: https://seekapi.ai/discovery-status
- Sourcing guide index: https://seekapi.ai/sourcing
